actual_scope: Compose PR3100 integer-labels-v1 with PR3273 XOR occurrence normalization and full symbolic checking before export, retaining exact selected artifacts and rejecting mixed fractional-label/duplicate-scatter inputs.
scope_change_reason: PR2977 duplicate semantics and PR3100 fractional-label coercion are already known, and PR3273 plus PR3326 already supply normalization and native replay. The missing composition allows the XOR boundary to accept the known fractional-label fixture; this separately versioned wrapper combines both existing contracts instead of rediscovering either defect.
bottleneck_link: A checker/exporter boundary must agree on geometry as well as scalar action. Composing the existing guards closes a concrete reliability gap without a supplier or kappa claim.
stop_rule: Stop after a source-bound compositional wrapper, public-entry regression controls, exact export comparisons, and a focused contribution. No native ownership or construction search expansion.
evidence: README.md, RESULT.json and the bounded verifier and behavioral controls registered in VERIFY.json. Validation claims are limited to the retained receipt and executed commands.
author: Pierre, with OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in source inspection, implementation, automated adversarial review, verification and writing. No independent human or proof-assistant review claimed.

selection.method: User-assigned exporter repair, refined after checking existing work; no random reroll.
selection.overlap: find_overlap.py --task supplier-boundary-audit --refresh --include-closed had no usable remote snapshot because gh was unavailable. Public GitHub API searches then covered all results for is:pr "xor-scatter" (11), scatter/nonempty (6), scatter/donor (23), and 3100 (4), with local README/source inspection and visible Discussion2976 and Discussion1166 content. No matching integer-label/XOR composition repair was identified. Further searches hit the unauthenticated API rate limit. Search metadata and visible discussion portions do not cover all diffs, hidden comments or unpublished work; this is not a novelty certificate.
selection.public_claim: None; bounded contribution, no advisory reservation.
